gloss.is: is — дієслово be: this is = це (є)

clips.line: And on Monday, they announced that they had found it.
clips.note: A physicist talks about scientists who looked for a signal from the early universe. On Monday, they announced that they had found it.
clips.noteUa: Фізик розповідає про вчених, які шукали сигнал із раннього Всесвіту. У понеділок вони оголосили, що знайшли його.

clips.line: Now, when they announced this in 2014 that this was going to be coming to Major League Baseball, they also made the announcement that this is seven terabytes of data every game.
clips.note: A talk about baseball and big data. In 2014 they announced a new system for the league, and they also said it gives 7 terabytes of data every game.
clips.noteUa: Лекція про бейсбол і великі дані. У 2014 році оголосили про нову систему для ліги й також повідомили, що вона дає 7 терабайтів даних за кожну гру.
around: Now, that’s a lot of data.

clips.line: Right before they announced that they were not going to charge this officer…
clips.note: Van Jones remembers working in Ferguson as a TV reporter, right before officials announced that they would not charge the police officer.
clips.noteUa: Ван Джонс згадує, як працював у Фергюсоні для CNN якраз перед тим, як влада оголосила, що не висуватиме звинувачень поліцейському.
around: Because when I was on the ground in Ferguson for CNN,
